cues: Bio engineering scales living reactions up to industry.
Its central machine is the bioreactor, or fermenter: a sterile stirred steel tank.
Probes watch the temperature, the p H and the dissolved oxygen; air bubbles in; the stirrer keeps everything mixed; and microbes or cultured cells make the product.
